# Azure Monitor Lab — Overview

Cross-scenario health roll-up reading from **VirtualMachines_CL**, **AppService_CL**, **AKS_CL**, **AzureSQL_CL**, and **APM_CL**. Shows table freshness, per-scenario headline signals, and active issues.

content.query:
let _checkWindow = 1h;
union
    (VirtualMachines_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_checkWindow)
     | summarize RowCount = count(), LastRow = max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend Scenario = "VirtualMachines"),
    (AppService_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_checkWindow)
     | summarize RowCount = count(), LastRow = max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend Scenario = "AppService"),
    (AKS_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_checkWindow)
     | summarize RowCount = count(), LastRow = max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend Scenario = "AKS"),
    (AzureSQL_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_checkWindow)
     | summarize RowCount = count(), LastRow = max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend Scenario = "AzureSQL"),
    (APM_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_checkWindow)
     | summarize RowCount = count(), LastRow = max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend Scenario = "APM")
| extend MinutesSinceLastRow = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastRow)
| extend FreshnessStatus = case(
    MinutesSinceLastRow <= 5,  "Fresh",
    MinutesSinceLastRow <= 15, "Stale",
    "No data")
| project Scenario, RowCount, LastRow, MinutesSinceLastRow, FreshnessStatus
| order by FreshnessStatus asc, Scenario asc
content.title: Table Freshness & Row Count

content.query:
let _window = 1h;
union
    (VirtualMachines_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_window)
     | summarize Value = max(CpuPercent)
     | extend Scenario = "VirtualMachines", Signal = "Max CPU %", Unit = "%"),
    (AppService_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_window)
     | summarize Total5xx = sum(Http5xxCount), TotalReqs = sum(RequestCount)
     | extend Value = iff(TotalReqs > 0, round(Total5xx * 100.0 / TotalReqs, 2), 0.0)
     | extend Scenario = "AppService", Signal = "5xx Error Rate", Unit = "%"),
    (AKS_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_window)
     | where PodReason == "CrashLoopBackOff"
     | summarize Value = toreal(dcount(PodName))
     | extend Scenario = "AKS", Signal = "CrashLoopBackOff Pods", Unit = "count"),
    (AzureSQL_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_window)
     | summarize Value = max(DtuPercent)
     | extend Scenario = "AzureSQL", Signal = "Peak DTU %", Unit = "%"),
    (APM_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_window) | where ItemType == "request"
     | summarize Value = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
     | extend Scenario = "APM", Signal = "P95 Latency", Unit = "ms")
| project Scenario, Signal, Value, Unit
| order by Scenario asc
content.title: Scenario Headline Signals (Last 1h)

content.query:
let _shortWindow = 5m;
union
    (VirtualMachines_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | summarize AvgCpu = avg(CpuPercent) by Resource, Environment
     | where AvgCpu > 90.0
     | extend Scenario = "VirtualMachines", Issue = "CPU > 90%",
              ResourceName = Resource, Detail = strcat("AvgCpu=", round(AvgCpu,1), "%")),
    (VirtualMachines_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | summarize LatestDiskFree = avg(DiskFreePercent) by Resource, DiskName, Environment
     | where LatestDiskFree < 10.0
     | extend Scenario = "VirtualMachines", Issue = "Disk free < 10%",
              ResourceName = Resource, Detail = strcat("DiskFree=", round(LatestDiskFree,1), "%")),
    (AppService_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | summarize Total5xx = sum(Http5xxCount), TotalReqs = sum(RequestCount)
         by Resource, Environment
     | where TotalReqs > 0 and Total5xx * 100.0 / TotalReqs > 5.0
     | extend Scenario = "AppService", Issue = "5xx rate > 5%",
              ResourceName = Resource,
              Detail = strcat("5xxRate=", round(Total5xx * 100.0 / TotalReqs, 1), "%")),
    (AKS_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | where PodReason == "CrashLoopBackOff"
     | summarize MaxRestarts = max(PodRestartCount) by Resource, Namespace, PodName, Environment
     | extend Scenario = "AKS", Issue = "CrashLoopBackOff",
              ResourceName = strcat(Resource, "/", Namespace, "/", PodName),
              Detail = strcat("Restarts=", MaxRestarts)),
    (AKS_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | where NodeStatus == "NotReady"
     | summarize Count = count() by Resource, NodeName, Environment
     | extend Scenario = "AKS", Issue = "Node NotReady",
              ResourceName = strcat(Resource, "/", NodeName),
              Detail = "NodeStatus=NotReady"),
    (AzureSQL_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | summarize AvgDtu = avg(DtuPercent) by Resource, DatabaseName, Environment
     | where AvgDtu > 85.0
     | extend Scenario = "AzureSQL", Issue = "DTU > 85%",
              ResourceName = strcat(Resource, "/", DatabaseName),
              Detail = strcat("AvgDtu=", round(AvgDtu,1), "%")),
    (APM_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(_shortWindow)
     | where ItemType == "request"
     | summarize TotalReqs = count(), FailedReqs = countif(IsSuccess == false)
         by Resource, Environment
     | where TotalReqs > 0 and FailedReqs * 100.0 / TotalReqs > 1.0
     | extend Scenario = "APM", Issue = "Failure rate > 1%",
              ResourceName = Resource,
              Detail = strcat("FailRate=", round(FailedReqs * 100.0 / TotalReqs, 2), "%"))
| project Scenario, Issue, ResourceName, Environment, Detail
| order by Scenario asc, Issue asc
content.title: Active Issues
